description:
You are using the Flight Crew View app on an Android device. The app is currently displayed with a light (white) color scheme. Your goal is to enable the system-wide Dark theme so that the app displays with dark-colored backgrounds.

To do this:
1. Navigate from the Flight Crew View app to the Android system Settings.
2. Open Display settings.
3. Enable Dark theme.
4. Return to the Flight Crew View app.
5. Confirm the app is now rendering with a dark color scheme.

When you are finished, the Flight Crew View app should be visible in the foreground with dark-themed colors, and the Android Dark theme should be enabled system-wide.
